findings.current: An hour or so ago, I think.
findings.defect: A shichen is approximately two hours, not one.
findings.rationale: The source places the hawks’ passage roughly one shichen earlier.
findings.replacement: About two hours ago, I think.

findings.current: I’ll go with the reinforcements as part of the second wave.
findings.defect: Namho says he will lead the reinforcements, not merely accompany them.
findings.rationale: 이끌고 assigns Namho an active leadership role; 되도록 also qualifies his intention.
findings.replacement: I’ll try to lead the reinforcements and follow behind you.

findings.defect: Using Sama Pyo’s full name removes the deliberate misnaming that prompts his correction.
findings.rationale: Taekyung calls him 마표 rather than 사마표, then confirms he did it on purpose.

findings.defect: The draft makes the people visually present; the bandit detects their presence.
findings.rationale: 인기척 refers to signs or the sensed presence of people, distinct from the visible flags.
findings.replacement: And he could sense dozens of people.

findings.current: It’s so quiet you can hear a mouse piss.
findings.defect: The draft introduces a crude image and profanity absent from the ordinary expression for dead silence.
findings.rationale: 쥐 죽은 듯이 조용한 describes an eerie absence of sound, not a sound made by a mouse.
findings.source: 아주 쥐 죽은 듯이 조용한 게

findings.current: I was still wondering when Namho smiled with satisfaction and pulled something from his pack.
findings.defect: The draft omits Taishan’s unexpectedly solemn demeanor, which sets up the food punchline.
findings.rationale: 사뭇 비장하기까지 한 그 모습 explicitly describes the appearance that puzzles the narrator.
findings.replacement: I was still wondering why Taishan looked downright solemn when Namho smiled with satisfaction and pulled something from his pack.
findings.source: 사뭇 비장하기까지 한 그 모습에 의문이 들던 그때, 흡족하게 웃은 남호가 행낭에서 무언가를 꺼내 들었다.

findings.current: but I won’t throw a tantrum when I’d only be a burden.
findings.defect: “Throw a tantrum” makes Hwaran’s restrained promise more childish and emphatic than the source.
findings.rationale: 괜한 투정 부리진 않을게요 is a measured promise not to make a fuss.
findings.replacement: but I know I’d only be a burden, so I won’t complain.
findings.source: 짐이 될 수는 없으니 괜한 투정 부리진 않을게요.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it changes a time interval and a sensory detail, loses a name-based joke and Namho’s role in the reinforcements, and adds profanity absent from the source.
